routes.title: Vulnerability triage
routes.summary: assessing and routing a reported security finding

applicability.text: Apply when a suspected product or dependency vulnerability is reported.

normativeRequirements.text: record severity evidence and an accountable owner before changing status.

rate severity with this rubric: Critical is exploitable now with no authentication; High is exploitable with low privileges; Medium needs user interaction or an unusual configuration; Low has limited impact.

exceptionsAndEscalation.text: If severity or ownership is uncertain, leave the finding open and escalate to the fictional product security lead.

routes.title: Secure coding
routes.summary: changing or reviewing application code at a trust boundary

applicability.text: Apply when code accepts untrusted input, handles credentials, or changes authorization behavior.

normativeRequirements.text: embed secrets in source, fixtures, logs, or error messages.
include a negative authorization test for security-sensitive changes.
validate untrusted values before using them at a trust boundary.

exceptionsAndEscalation.text: An exception requires a named owner, rationale, compensating control, approving authority, and expiry.
If authority or policy meaning is uncertain, stop the affected change and escalate to the fictional security owner.
